title: 第5章 师刀坛-《我发现了世界BUG》
content:
第(1/3)页

    徐长顺家距离市区并不算远，也就是在市区边缘一个叫茶城的小县城里。

    对林舒来说，这一点其实也有点反直觉。

    他还以为，所有的“师公”都是住在深山老林里的呢。

    不过也是，师公是要做事的，住在深山老林里哪里方便帮平民百姓做事啊？

    看来梅山派的原则跟华夏大部分神明的原则都是一样的，你得先有用。

    要是没用，那你就不是神了......

    打了个车一路直奔动车站，林舒买了时间最近的动车票去往茶城。

    车程只有半个小时，到站后，车站外面围满了拉客的司机。

    “莲花！莲花！上车就走！”

    “朝川！朝川！”

    “县城！县城15块！轿车！”

    林舒掏出手机看了一样打车软件，价格差不多，但司机很少，他便干脆跟着那个叫价15块的司机走了。

    到停车场一看，嘿，就是趴活儿的出租车。

    “靓仔，没行李啊？临川回来的？”

    “是啊是啊。”

    林舒随口回答道：

    “去太平街五巷15号。”

    “太平街五巷15号......哎？”

    司机猛地回过头来。

    “你去徐师公那里啊？”

    林舒被他问得一愣。

    “是啊----你认识？”

    “害。”

    司机回过头去反手挂上档。

    “这县城里谁不认识他啊？不说都打过照面吧，多多少少都听说过。”

    “我跟他还是隔壁村的呢，之前老家起新房也是找他看的。”

    “徐师公人很好的，可惜了......”

    “是可惜了......”

    林舒随意应和着，不太想搭话----说多错多，他现在身上压着沉重的秘密，生怕不小心把秘密透出来。

    但小县城的司机，却是格外健谈。

    “你跟徐师公认识啊？”

    “......算是认识吧，以前他帮过我。”

    “哦......来上志的？”

    上志在方言里就是吊唁的意思，林舒点头道：

    “是啊，受过他恩惠，他走了我怎么都要送一程。”

    “那你不应该去县城啊，你得去村里----双溪村，他已经回去了。”

    双溪村？
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Xu Changshun’s home is not far from the urban area, that is, it is in a small county called Tea City on the edge of the urban area.

For Lin Shu, this is actually a bit counter-intuitive.

He thought that all "masters" lived in deep mountains and old forests.

But yes, Master has to do things. How can he help the common people while living in the mountains and forests?

It seems that the principles of the Meishan Sect are the same as those of most gods in China. You must be useful first.

If it doesn’t work, then you are not a god...

After taking a taxi and heading straight to the train station, Lin Shu bought the nearest train ticket to the tea city.

The journey took only half an hour. When we arrived at the station, we were surrounded by drivers soliciting customers.

"Lotus! Lotus! Get in the car and leave!"

"Asakawa! Asakawa!"

"County town! County town 15 yuan! Car!"

Lin Shu took out his mobile phone and looked at a taxi app. The prices were about the same, but there were very few drivers, so he simply followed the driver who asked for 15 yuan.

Went to the parking lot and saw, hey, it’s just a taxi.

“Young man, you don’t have any luggage? Are you coming back from Linchuan?”

"Yes, yes."

Lin Shu replied casually:

"Go to No. 15, Lane 5, Taiping Street."

"No. 15, Lane 5, Taiping Street... Huh?"

The driver turned around suddenly.

"Are you going to Master Xu's place?"

Lin Shu was stunned by his question.

"Yes----you know him?"

"Harm."

The driver turned around and shifted gears with his backhand.

“Who doesn’t know him in this county? I’ve probably met him before, and I’ve heard of him more or less.”

"He and I are from the next village. I used to go to him to look at new houses in my hometown."

"Master Xu is a very nice person, it's a pity..."

"It's a pity..."

Lin Shu responded casually, not wanting to talk - he would make many mistakes if he said so. He was carrying a heavy secret now, and he was afraid of accidentally revealing the secret.

But drivers in small counties are particularly talkative.

"Do you know Master Xu?"

"...I think we know each other, he has helped me before."

"Oh...are you here for Shangzhi?"

"Shangzhi" means condolence in dialect. Lin Shu nodded and said:

"Yes, I have received his favor, and I will give him a ride no matter what when he leaves."

"Then you shouldn't go to the county seat. You have to go to the village - Shuangxi Village. He has already gone back."

Shuangxi Village?
